blocks.text: Duplexes and half duplexes in Morgan Crossing
Local rules that affect duplexes in Morgan Crossing

items.t: Plan and zoning (Surrey): The current plan is the Surrey 2050 OCP, Bylaw 21900 (adopted Jun 15, 2026) — Bylaw 18020 is replaced and is never cited as current. Zoning Bylaw 12000 governs. Streamside setbacks sit in Part 7A of Zoning 12000 and vary by stream class — no single riparian figure is ever stated.

Suites inside a duplex (Surrey): A secondary suite's habitable floor area may not exceed 40% of the principal dwelling unit's habitable area — Surrey's own cap, never borrowed from another city; a "90 m²" cap is not the current Surrey suite rule.

Servicing and registry (Surrey): Subdivision and Development (Servicing) Bylaw 8830 (1986) is verified from the City's own pages. Surrey has no Supreme Court registry — foreclosure registry mapping is not verified and is never filled in.

items.t: No SkyTrain station serves Morgan Crossing. Route 351 (TransLink) runs from Bridgeport Station on the Canada Line via the South Surrey Park & Ride to White Rock Centre.
Route 531 (TransLink), White Rock Centre / Willowbrook, runs via 24 Ave and 152 St.
Route 345 (TransLink) runs between White Rock Centre and King George Station via 152 St.
White Rock Centre is the named terminus on routes 351, 531 and 345.

blocks.text: Morgan Crossing Homes for Sale: streets and boundaries

items.t: Morgan Crossing is a retail village, not the Morgan Creek golf community. It sits at 24 Avenue and Croydon Drive in Grandview Heights, South Surrey, with homes above and beside the shops on Croydon Drive and 26 Avenue addresses, listed on the board mainly under the Grandview sub-area.

The wider plan ground is Morgan Heights, Grandview Heights Neighbourhood Concept Plan (NCP) Area 1, bordered by 28 Avenue north, 24 Avenue south, 164 Street east and the Highway 99 corridor plan west, about 80 hectares.
The Shops at Morgan Crossing describe themselves as an open-air, pedestrian-friendly urban village with over 60 shops and services — that village is the landmark buyers mean by the name.

blocks.text: Morgan Crossing Homes for Sale: the housing stock

items.t: The homes here are mainly strata condos in low-rise buildings over and beside the village shops. The Morgan Heights plan that framed this ground features a mix of housing types centred on Southridge Private School, and the City states the plan is now largely built out.

Grandview Corners and Morgan Crossing together form the commercial core the Orchard Grove plan describes as about 92,900 square metres (one million square feet) of commercial space near 24 Avenue and 168 Street.

blocks.text: Morgan Crossing Homes for Sale: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The Morgan Heights NCP no longer governs on its own. The City states it was rescinded by the Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan update and development is now led by the Official Community Plan (OCP).
A Morgan Crossing unit is strata, so the building's own bylaws and depreciation report, not the NCP, set rental, pet and parking rules for that unit.

blocks.text: Morgan Crossing Homes for Sale: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The aquatic centre and the secondary school share one corner, at 24 Avenue and 168 Street, so school and pool traffic peaks overlap on weekday mornings and afternoons.
Southridge Private School is the centre the Morgan Heights plan was built around, so independent-school traffic is part of the local pattern separate from the public catchments.

The village streetscape is open-air, so a unit over Croydon Drive faces shop, restaurant and parking activity rather than a closed mall — check the unit's floor and outlook against the village plan for that building.
Grandview Heights was guided first by the 2005 General Land Use Plan, so building ages cluster in planned phases rather than spreading evenly by street.

blocks.text: Morgan Crossing Homes for Sale: development and new projects

items.t: Grandview Heights Area 5 NCP — the last unplanned Grandview area, east of the built Morgan and Sunnyside ground; STATUS: City staff recommended starting the NCP process in Corporate Report R144 for July 13, 2026, with engagement expected near the end of 2026 and a final stage in spring 2028, read 2026-11-03.
Grandview Heights Aquatic Centre, 16855 24 Avenue, City of Surrey — 10-lane 50-metre pool facility beside Grandview Heights Secondary; STATUS: completed, opened June 2016, read 2026-11-03.

blocks.text: Morgan Crossing Homes for Sale: costs and taxes

items.t: Strata fees are building-specific and are not stated here.
The Speculation and Vacancy Tax (SVT) applies here, because the Province lists the City of Surrey as a designated taxable area.

blocks.text: Morgan Crossing Homes for Sale: getting around

items.t: Highway 99 is the west driving edge, with interchanges at 24 Avenue and 32 Avenue serving the Grandview ground.
Route 351 is the regional bus spine for South Surrey, running from Bridgeport Station (Canada Line) via Highway 99 and the South Surrey Park and Ride to White Rock Centre.

blocks.text: Morgan Crossing Homes for Sale: risks and due diligence

items.t: Read the strata documents for the specific building first, because rental, pet, parking and storage rules here are strata bylaws, not City rules, and they differ by building in the village.
Confirm the school catchment for the exact unit address in the district locator, because listings in this one cluster name two different secondary schools.

faq.q: The card for 353 15850 26 Avenue shows two open-house times — which is right?
faq.a: Neither can be treated as authoritative from the page alone: The time block reads 2:00–4:00 PM and the line beneath it reads 1:00–3:00 PM for Sunday, November 1, 2026 — exactly one hour apart. The item lives with the open-houses topic; confirm the time with the listing brokerage before setting out.

faq.q: Can a suite be added inside a Surrey duplex?
faq.a: Surrey's own cap governs: A secondary suite's habitable floor area may not exceed 40% of the principal dwelling unit's habitable area.

faq.q: Which secondary school serves a Morgan Crossing unit?
faq.a: Check the unit's exact address, because two secondaries are named for this cluster.

faq.q: What recreation is walkable from the village?
faq.a: Grandview Heights Aquatic Centre is the anchor, at 16855 24 Avenue. The City lists it as a one-stop facility for lane, public and leisure swimming and diving, with a weight room, cafe and outdoor deck, at the corner of 24 Avenue and 168 Street east of the village.

faq.q: Is there rapid transit at Morgan Crossing?
faq.a: No, there is no SkyTrain or RapidBus station in the village. The practical transit spine is bus service on 24 Avenue, with Highway 99 and the South Surrey Park and Ride handling the regional trip via Route 351 to Bridgeport Station, so confirm the current stop for the building.

faq.q: Is Morgan Crossing the same as Morgan Creek?
faq.a: No. Morgan Crossing is the retail village at 24 Ave / 160 St in Grandview Heights — residences above and beside the village shops, on Croydon Drive and 26 Avenue. Morgan Creek is the separate golf-course community. The board sub-area row for Morgan Crossing's ground is Grandview: Detached 66 / 9 / 14% and Condos & Townhomes 146 / 20 / 14% in September 2026 (SnapStats, September 2026)

faq.q: What kind of homes are for sale at Morgan Crossing?
faq.a: At reading, the feed held 14 listings; the cards read in full were all apartment-style condos of 1–2 bedrooms and 720–941 sq ft, priced $469,000–$599,000, in buildings the page dates from 2008 to 2011, plus The Brownstones townhomes next door in the page's building table. That is a feed snapshot at reading, not a statistic.

faq.q: The card shows two different open-house times — which one is right?
faq.a: Neither can be treated as authoritative from the page alone: the card for 353 15850 26 Avenue shows a time block of 2:00–4:00 PM and a line beneath it of 1:00–3:00 PM for Sunday, November 1, 2026 — exactly one hour apart. Confirm the time with the listing brokerage before setting out.
